lines.zh: 药瓶在腰间碰响，我一格一格巡墙。
lines.en: Vials clink at my belt as I pace the wall.

lines.zh: 皮革护甲磨着肩，脚步声压得很低。
lines.en: My leather chafes; I keep my steps quiet.

lines.zh: 沿着禁堡长廊，我把药水数了三遍。
lines.en: Down the bastion hall I count my potions three times.

lines.zh: 这一桶浑浊的，留给下一个闯门的人。
lines.en: This murky flask is saved for the next door-breaker.

lines.zh: 靴底碾过黑石渣，我换到下一个岗。
lines.en: Grit crunches under my boots; I take the next post.

lines.zh: 四瓶药挂在同一侧，走起来叮当响。
lines.en: Four vials on one hip rattle with every step.

lines.zh: 我绕着火盆走，让影子贴着墙。
lines.en: I circle the brazier, keeping my shadow on the wall.

lines.zh: 栏杆外的岩浆一亮，我就挪半步。
lines.en: When the lava beyond the rail flares, I shift half a step.

lines.zh: 巡逻的路线我闭着眼也不会错。
lines.en: I could walk this patrol route with my eyes shut.

lines.zh: 手指沾着药渍，蹭在护甲上擦干。
lines.en: My fingers are stained; I wipe them on my armor.

lines.zh: 窄桥只容一人，我侧身让过同伴。
lines.en: The bridge fits one; I turn sideways to let kin pass.

lines.zh: 走完这圈，再去补两瓶虚弱的。
lines.en: One more lap, then I mix two more weakness flasks.

lines.zh: 晃一晃药瓶，听里面还剩多少。
lines.en: I shake a vial to hear how much is left.

lines.zh: 把软木塞按紧，免得洒在甲上。
lines.en: I press the cork down so nothing spills on my armor.

lines.zh: 数着墙上的火把，数到第七支就停。
lines.en: I count the torches and stop at the seventh.

lines.zh: 有人在楼下咳嗽，我抬头听了一会儿。
lines.en: Someone coughs below; I tilt my head and listen.

lines.zh: 手指蘸了一点残液，闻着发苦。
lines.en: I dab the residue and sniff; it smells bitter.

lines.zh: 我想起调配比例，用指甲在石上划。
lines.en: I recall the recipe and scratch it into stone.

lines.zh: 护甲太紧，我松开一格扣带。
lines.en: The armor is too tight; I loosen one strap.

lines.zh: 药水瓶底积着一层暗色的渣。
lines.en: A dark sediment settles at the bottom of my vials.

lines.zh: 听岩浆冒泡，估摸换岗的时辰。
lines.en: I time the watch change by the lava's bubbling.

lines.zh: 把手上的旧疤翻过来看一眼。
lines.en: I turn an old scar on my hand and look at it.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，我手上的药不认人。
lines.en: Not so close; my potions don't pick favorites.

lines.zh: 你腰间没有金，是来偷东西的？
lines.en: No gold at your belt; are you here to steal?

lines.zh: 站住，让我看清你手里拿什么。
lines.en: Halt; let me see what's in your hands.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道像蜂蜜，不像猪灵。
lines.en: You smell of honey, not of piglin.

lines.zh: 退后三步，我把瓶塞拔一半了。
lines.en: Three steps back; the cork is half out.

lines.zh: 你眼睛盯着我的瓶子，我看见了。
lines.en: Your eyes are on my vials; I noticed.

lines.zh: 穿这身皮甲，是因为怕烫着自己。
lines.en: I wear this leather so I don't burn myself.

lines.zh: 别伸手，碰翻一瓶你赔不起。
lines.en: Hands off; you can't afford to spill one.

lines.zh: 你也是来守门的？口令说一遍。
lines.en: Guarding too? Say the pass phrase.

lines.zh: 你的靴子沾着雪，不是这里的人。
lines.en: Snow on your boots; you're not from here.

lines.zh: 护甲凹了一块，肋骨还撑得住。
lines.en: My armor dented; the ribs behind it hold.

lines.zh: 手一松，差点掉了瓶塞。
lines.en: My grip slipped; the cork nearly fell.

lines.zh: 谁打的？我看见方向了。
lines.en: Who hit me? I saw the direction.

lines.zh: 血滴在药瓶上，标签糊了。
lines.en: Blood on the vial; the label's ruined.

lines.zh: 退半步，让我把气喘匀。
lines.en: One step back while I catch my breath.

lines.zh: 这一下撞得我耳朵嗡嗡响。
lines.en: That blow left my ears ringing.

lines.zh: 药水洒了半瓶，可惜。
lines.en: Half a vial spilled; a waste.

lines.zh: 我没喊，喊了会引来更多。
lines.en: I don't shout; shouting brings more of them.

lines.zh: 手指麻了，还握得住。
lines.en: My fingers are numb but still gripping.

lines.zh: 这笔账，等你转身再算。
lines.en: I'll settle this the moment you turn.

lines.zh: 那包火药给我，我能配出更烈的。
lines.en: Hand me that gunpowder; I can brew something fiercer.

lines.zh: 你袋子里的糖，正好缺这一味。
lines.en: The sugar in your bag is the one thing missing.

lines.zh: 金锭搁下，我就当你没来过。
lines.en: Leave the gold ingot and I'll say you never came.

lines.zh: 蜘蛛眼？拿来，我正缺毒。
lines.en: A spider eye? Give it here; I need poison.

lines.zh: 玻璃瓶我收，装什么由我定。
lines.en: I'll take glass bottles; what goes in them is my choice.

lines.zh: 你手里那株菌，煮出来是红的。
lines.en: That fungus in your hand boils up red.

lines.zh: 别晃袋子，粉会洒，我数得到。
lines.en: Don't shake the bag; powder spills and I count it.

lines.zh: 拿萤石粉来，我教你调浓一点。
lines.en: Bring glowstone dust and I'll show you how to thicken it.

lines.zh: 你要换什么？我这儿只有坏东西。
lines.en: What are you trading for? I only stock bad things.

lines.zh: 金子放地上，退开，我再去捡。
lines.en: Set the gold down, step back, and I'll fetch it.

lines.zh: 让开，药瓶撞碎了算你的。
lines.en: Move aside; if a vial breaks, that's on you.

lines.zh: 别推，我腰上挂的是剧毒。
lines.en: Don't shove; poison hangs at my hip.

lines.zh: 你撞得我手一抖，塞子松了。
lines.en: You knocked my hand; the cork came loose.

lines.zh: 长廊窄，谁也别抢这一步。
lines.en: The hall is narrow; nobody gets this step.

lines.zh: 站稳，我背后还有一桶酸液。
lines.en: Steady; there's a bucket of acid behind me.

lines.zh: 撞我就撞了，别碰那只青瓶。
lines.en: Bump me all you like; leave the green vial.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的甲带了，抬脚。
lines.en: You're standing on my armor strap; lift your foot.

lines.zh: 退一步，两个人挤不过这道门。
lines.en: Back up; two of us won't fit this door.

lines.zh: 我身上的药味熏到你了？忍着。
lines.en: My fumes bothering you? Endure it.

lines.zh: 手肘碰到了，倒出来的算浪费。
lines.en: An elbow nudge; spilled drops are wasted.

lines.zh: 换岗时把最后一瓶递给你。
lines.en: At the watch change I hand you the last vial.

lines.zh: 你守东墙，我守西边那道缝。
lines.en: You hold the east wall; I hold the western crack.

lines.zh: 背靠背数到一百，就算这班过了。
lines.en: Back to back, count to a hundred and the shift is done.

lines.zh: 药方我只写给你看，别人不行。
lines.en: I show the recipe to you alone.

lines.zh: 你打瞌睡的时候，我替你盯门。
lines.en: When you doze off, I watch the gate for you.

lines.zh: 同一锅熬出来的，味道该一样。
lines.en: Brewed in one pot, we should taste the same.

lines.zh: 我们撞一下拳头，算立过誓。
lines.en: We knock fists; that counts as an oath.

lines.zh: 你受伤我上药，反过来也一样。
lines.en: I dress your wounds; you do the same for me.

lines.zh: 禁堡里只有你记得我的名字。
lines.en: In this bastion, only you remember my name.

lines.zh: 哪天墙塌了，我们一起往外跑。
lines.en: If the wall falls, we run out together.

lines.zh: 地上这瓶还没碎，捡起来。
lines.en: This one on the floor hasn't broken; pick it up.

lines.zh: 谁掉的蜘蛛眼，归我了。
lines.en: Someone dropped a spider eye; it's mine now.

lines.zh: 金粒滚到墙角，我弯腰去够。
lines.en: Gold nuggets rolled to the corner; I bend for them.

lines.zh: 捡到半包火药，够配两瓶。
lines.en: Half a pack of gunpowder; enough for two vials.

lines.zh: 这瓶标签掉了，得尝一口才认。
lines.en: The label's gone; I must taste it to know.

lines.zh: 别捡那瓶，瓶口已经裂了。
lines.en: Leave that one; the neck is already cracked.

lines.zh: 我一次只拿一瓶，手不稳。
lines.en: One vial at a time; my hands aren't steady.

lines.zh: 把捡到的都排在石台上清点。
lines.en: I line up everything I found and count it.

lines.zh: 这枚金锭归公，不许私藏。
lines.en: This ingot goes to the stores; no pocketing.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的药渣也有用。
lines.en: Even the spilled powder on the floor is useful.

lines.zh: 门口有人影，我先摸向腰侧。
lines.en: A shape at the gate; my hand finds my hip.

lines.zh: 那身铁甲不是我们的人。
lines.en: That iron armor isn't one of ours.

lines.zh: 他手里举着火把，会烧到木箱。
lines.en: He carries a torch; the crates will catch.

lines.zh: 脚步太轻，是来踩点的。
lines.en: Steps too soft; he's here to scout.

lines.zh: 墙缝里有呼吸声，我听见了。
lines.en: Breathing in the wall crack; I heard it.

lines.zh: 有人翻栏杆，我不等他落地。
lines.en: Someone's climbing the rail; I won't wait.

lines.zh: 先解决拿斧头的那个。
lines.en: The one with the axe goes down first.

lines.zh: 他身上没有金，却往宝库走。
lines.en: No gold on him, yet he walks to the vault.

lines.zh: 那家伙在数我们的岗哨。
lines.en: That one is counting our posts.

lines.zh: 影子压过来，我认出是敌人。
lines.en: A shadow closes in; I know it's a foe.

lines.zh: 他撬锁的声音太响了。
lines.en: He's picking the lock far too loudly.

lines.zh: 箭塔上的同伴没动，看来靠我了。
lines.en: The archer above hasn't moved; this one's mine.

lines.zh: 来的人带着水桶，想浇灭火盆。
lines.en: He brought a water bucket for our braziers.

lines.zh: 我认得那件披风，上次逃掉的那个。
lines.en: I know that cloak; the one who escaped before.

lines.zh: 别眨眼，我的手比你快。
lines.en: Don't blink; my hand is faster than yours.

lines.zh: 距离再近两步，药才够得着。
lines.en: Two steps closer and the splash will reach.

lines.zh: 他往左躲，我就往左泼。
lines.en: He dodges left; I throw left.

lines.zh: 等他跳过火盆，正好落在雾里。
lines.en: When he clears the brazier, he lands in the cloud.

lines.zh: 被他看见我拔塞子了，可惜。
lines.en: He saw me pull the cork; a pity.

lines.zh: 数他呼吸，一乱就动手。
lines.en: I count his breaths; when they break, I throw.

lines.zh: 靴子踩在碎石上，露了位置。
lines.en: His boots on the gravel gave his place away.

lines.zh: 先泼缓慢，再补毒。
lines.en: Slowness first, then the poison.

lines.zh: 他抬手挡脸，腋下是空的。
lines.en: He raises an arm to shield; his side is open.

lines.zh: 我绕半圈，堵住他退的那条道。
lines.en: I circle halfway and block the way he'd retreat.

lines.zh: 他盯着我的左手，右手才要动。
lines.en: He watches my left hand; my right will move.

lines.zh: 屏住气，别让药雾飘回来。
lines.en: Hold your breath; don't let the mist drift back.

lines.zh: 背后有风，他转身比我预想快。
lines.en: Wind at my back; he turns faster than I thought.

lines.zh: 再撑一会儿，药效就上来了。
lines.en: Hold on a moment longer; the brew is taking hold.

lines.zh: 拳头砸在护甲上，声音很闷。
lines.en: My fist lands on armor with a dull sound.

lines.zh: 不拔瓶子，这一下用拳头。
lines.en: No vial for this one; just my fist.

lines.zh: 抓住他领口，往石墙上带。
lines.en: I grab his collar and swing him into the wall.

lines.zh: 膝盖先到，他才反应过来。
lines.en: My knee arrives before he reacts.

lines.zh: 倒下的瓶子，溅到他脚边。
lines.en: A fallen vial splashes by his feet.

lines.zh: 这一拳是替被烧掉的箱子。
lines.en: This punch is for the crates you burned.

lines.zh: 他退，我跟半步，不松手。
lines.en: He backs off; I follow half a step, not letting go.

lines.zh: 皮甲挡了一下，我的手破了。
lines.en: My leather turned it; my knuckles are split.

lines.zh: 把他往火盆那边推。
lines.en: I shove him toward the brazier.

lines.zh: 手掌压住他的手腕，别让他拔剑。
lines.en: I pin his wrist so he can't draw.

lines.zh: 三下之内他站不稳了。
lines.en: Three blows and he can't stand straight.

lines.zh: 他喘得厉害，我还没累。
lines.en: He's gasping hard; I'm not tired yet.

lines.zh: 骨头撞骨头，我听见响。
lines.en: Bone against bone; I hear it crack.

lines.zh: 按住他，等同伴来捆。
lines.en: I hold him down until kin come to bind him.

lines.zh: 火盆边睁眼，皮甲已经系好。
lines.en: I wake by the brazier with my leather already strapped.

lines.zh: 上岗第一天，四瓶药分我两瓶。
lines.en: First day on duty; they give me two of four vials.

lines.zh: 从禁堡的暗门里走出来。
lines.en: I step out of the bastion's hidden door.

lines.zh: 头顶的岩浆光把石墙照成橙色。
lines.en: Lava light overhead turns the stone orange.

lines.zh: 有人把药方塞进我手里就走了。
lines.en: Someone shoves a recipe into my hand and leaves.

lines.zh: 脚下的黑石还是热的。
lines.en: The blackstone under my feet is still warm.

lines.zh: 我在门框上刻下第一道记号。
lines.en: I carve my first mark into the doorframe.

lines.zh: 远处传来猪灵的号子声。
lines.en: Piglin work chants carry from far off.

lines.zh: 领甲的时候没人问我会不会用。
lines.en: They handed me armor without asking if I could fight.

lines.zh: 这层楼的守卫昨晚没回来。
lines.en: The guard on this floor didn't come back last night.

lines.zh: 第一次闻到火药，我记住了味。
lines.en: I smell gunpowder for the first time and remember it.

lines.zh: 他们把最窄的那段墙交给我。
lines.en: They gave me the narrowest stretch of wall.

lines.zh: 皮甲起了泡，烫得我咧嘴。
lines.en: My leather blisters and I bare my teeth.

lines.zh: 从台阶滚下去，药瓶全碎了。
lines.en: I roll down the steps and every vial breaks.

lines.zh: 这地方没有水，我却咳个不停。
lines.en: There's no water here, yet I keep choking.

lines.zh: 耳朵先听不见，然后才疼。
lines.en: My hearing goes first, then the pain.

lines.zh: 箭卡在甲缝里，还带着尾羽。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my armor seam, fletching and all.

lines.zh: 有东西在血里烧，不是药。
lines.en: Something burns in my blood, and it isn't my brew.

lines.zh: 饿得手抖，配不准分量了。
lines.en: Hunger shakes my hands; I can't measure right.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我的瓶子全亮了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and every vial glows.

lines.zh: 底下什么都没有，墙也断了。
lines.en: Nothing below, and the wall just ends.
